summary: Complete testing of Admin panel Users Manager feature. All 14 features tested: Kullanıcılar sidebar, user list table, search/filter functionality, user drawer with 5 tabs (Özet, Üyelik, Yetkiler, Aktivite, Notlar), save operations, status changes, membership management, permissions, activity logs, notes, and end-sessions. Backend: 23/23 tests passed. Frontend: All features working end-to-end.

issues: 'Başlangıç Tarihi' uses browser native date picker (input type=date) showing 'mm/dd/yyyy' placeholder. Functionally works but may feel inconsistent with rest of UI. Minor cosmetic issue only.

critical_code_review_comments: HTML validity: <tr> rows are wrapped in a <span> by the platform's visual editor which causes a hydration warning in console ('In HTML, tr cannot be a child of span'). This is from the platform's dynamic content wrapping, not a code issue - no action needed.
The role filter only has 'Kullanıcı' role users in the app_users collection - admin users are stored in db.users (separate collection). This is by design but worth documenting.

UserUpdateAdmin model includes 'status', 'admin_note', and 'tags' fields but the summary tab only sends 'full_name', 'phone', 'role' via PUT /api/admin/app-users/:id - model has unused optional fields. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Modified test user 'testuser@test.com' during testing: name updated to 'Test User Updated UI', membership extended 30 days (end_at ~05/03/2026), plan changed to 'pro' then 'free', permissions updated, note 'UI test note - automated test run' with tag 'UITest' added, status cycled through passive/banned/active (restored to active).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Users Manager fully tested and working. All endpoints verified: GET /api/admin/app-users (list, search, filter), GET /api/admin/app-users/:id, PUT /api/admin/app-users/:id (update info), PUT /api/admin/app-users/:id/status, PUT /api/admin/app-users/:id/membership (plan + extend), PUT /api/admin/app-users/:id/permissions, PUT /api/admin/app-users/:id/note, GET /api/admin/app-users/:id/activity, POST /api/admin/app-users/:id/end-sessions. Admin auth uses JWT via POST /api/auth/login (stored as admin_token in localStorage). Test user user_e77f531cd141 (testuser@test.com) was used for testing and has test data in it.
